answer: A payout is split so that 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The quartz schedule is applied in voyage and oasis makes public each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1947 identities would post 1313 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
